# Cyprus Tax Calculator

> Free calculator for Cyprus net salary under the 2025 rules and the 2026 tax
> reform: income tax bands, Social Insurance (8.8%), GESY (2.65%), the 20%/25%/50%
> newcomer exemptions, and the new 2026 family deductions (children, housing,
> eco upgrades, insurance). Salary calculations run in the browser without an account. Built by Abasis.AI.

The calculator is available in English, Greek and Russian. Each language lives
at its own path and carries the same content.

## Pages

- [Salary calculator (English)](https://cyprustaxcalculator.abasis.ai/): net
  salary from gross for 2025 and 2026 side by side, with the full deduction
  breakdown, employer cost, and a 2026-reform FAQ based on official Cyprus Tax
  Department guidance.
- [Υπολογιστής μισθού (Ελληνικά)](https://cyprustaxcalculator.abasis.ai/el/)
- [Калькулятор зарплаты (Русский)](https://cyprustaxcalculator.abasis.ai/ru/)
- [2025 tax return helper, form TD.1](https://cyprustaxcalculator.abasis.ai/declaration/):
  prepares the 2025 income tax return filed in TAXISnet in 2026. Imports the employer's
  IR63A certificate or takes the amounts by hand, adds income and deductions the
  certificate does not cover, flags what needs review, and lists each figure against
  the TAXISnet field it goes into. It does not submit the return; the person checks
  the figures and files it themselves. Free, no account.
  Also at /el/declaration/ and /ru/declaration/.
- [Check a filed return, form T.D.1](https://cyprustaxcalculator.abasis.ai/check/):
  reads the PDF of a return already submitted and compares its calculation with the
  calculator's. The PDF stays on the device; a report is sent only if the person
  chooses to share it. Also at /el/check/ and /ru/check/.
- [TD.1 browser extension and installation guide](https://cyprustaxcalculator.abasis.ai/extension/):
  get the Chrome Web Store extension, learn what it fills in TAXISnet and what still
  needs a manual check. Also at /el/extension/ and /ru/extension/.

## Guides

Step-by-step guides to Cyprus tax paperwork, written from the official forms, the
department's own guides and the law. Each guide exists in English, Greek and Russian
at /guides/<slug>/, /el/guides/<slug>/ and /ru/guides/<slug>/.

- [Guides index](https://cyprustaxcalculator.abasis.ai/guides/)
- [Getting a Cyprus tax number through Tax For All](https://cyprustaxcalculator.abasis.ai/guides/tin/):
  creating the portal account, the eligibility check, the documents each category has to
  attach, the REG reference number, processing time, and the TAXISnet account that
  follows automatically.
- [Non-dom status and form T.D.38](https://cyprustaxcalculator.abasis.ai/guides/non-dom/):
  who still qualifies for exemption from the Special Contribution for Defence, the T.D.38
  declaration with questionnaires T.D.38Qa and T.D.38Qb, the evidence the Tax Department
  asks for, stopping the deduction at source, the three-year renewal, the 17-of-20 rule,
  and the €250,000 alternative method under article 3D.
- [Tax residence certificate](https://cyprustaxcalculator.abasis.ai/guides/tax-residence-certificate/):
  when the Tax Department issues one, the double tax treaty precondition, the €80 stamp
  fee and when it is paid, form T.F.126 for individuals and T.F.98 for companies, the
  documents the district office asks for, how days are counted under the 183-day rule,
  and the five conditions of the 60-day rule.
- [The 50% exemption, article 8(23A)](https://cyprustaxcalculator.abasis.ai/guides/exemption-50-percent/):
  the versions before and after amending law 51(I)/2023, the €55,000 test and how it is
  measured, the 17-year period, what changing employer or leaving Cyprus does, and how
  the exemption is claimed through PAYE on form T.D.59.
- [The 25% exemption, article 8(21B)](https://cyprustaxcalculator.abasis.ai/guides/exemption-25-percent/):
  the Talent Repatriation Scheme — seven years of absence after having been a Cyprus tax
  resident, the €30,000 floor and €25,000 cap, the qualification and 36-or-84-month work
  test, and the fact that it is the only one of the three open to the self-employed.
- [The 20% exemption, article 8(21A)](https://cyprustaxcalculator.abasis.ai/guides/exemption-20-percent/):
  no minimum salary and no degree, the €8,550 annual cap, the three years abroad and the
  four-month gap rule, the seven years starting the year after employment begins, and why
  a change of employer ends it.
- [Filing the 2025 tax return in TAXISnet](https://cyprustaxcalculator.abasis.ai/guides/file-return-2025/):
  who must file for 2025, what to collect, the return part by part, the department's own
  list of common mistakes, Final Submit, paying in the Tax Portal, the 31 October 2026
  deadline and what late filing costs, and how to correct a return already filed.

- [Form T.D.59, the employee declaration](https://cyprustaxcalculator.abasis.ai/guides/ir59/):
  what goes in each part, how the 2026 deductions are entered as one figure per category,
  how the relocation exemptions reach PAYE through it, and the cost of not filing one.
- [Renting out property](https://cyprustaxcalculator.abasis.ai/guides/rental-income/):
  income tax, the defence contribution up to 2025 and its abolition from 2026, GESY and
  the self-assessment codes, the 20% allowance and capital allowances, VAT and the
  T.F.1220 election, Airbnb income, and the electronic-payment duty from 1 July 2026.
- [Self-employed](https://cyprustaxcalculator.abasis.ai/guides/self-employed/):
  social insurance at 16.6% of a deemed income by occupational category, GESY at 4%,
  temporary tax in two instalments, the accounts and audit threshold, and the €15,600 VAT
  registration tests.
- [The 2026 tax reform for individuals](https://cyprustaxcalculator.abasis.ai/guides/reform-2026/):
  the €22,000 tax-free amount and the new bands, the deductions for children, housing,
  energy upgrades and home insurance with their income criteria, the defence contribution
  at 5% on dividends and its abolition on rents, and the filing duty for ages 25 to 70.
- [How the tax on a salary is worked out](https://cyprustaxcalculator.abasis.ai/guides/how-tax-is-calculated/):
  the eleven steps from gross to net with their formulas — social insurance at 8.8% up to
  €68,904, GESY at 2.65% up to €180,000, the one-fifth cap, the 20/25/50% exemptions, the
  2026 deductions, the bands and monthly withholding — on one example of €5,000 a month.
- [TAXISnet or Tax For All: which Cyprus tax portal to use](https://cyprustaxcalculator.abasis.ai/guides/which-portal/):
  the tax year decides the portal: TAXISnet for returns up to 2025, Tax For All from
  2026 and for your registration, messages and IBAN, the Tax Portal for paying.
- [Cyprus tax deadlines for individuals: the 2025 return, provisional tax and the 2026 return](https://cyprustaxcalculator.abasis.ai/guides/filing-deadlines/):
  the 2025 return and balance by 31 October 2026, the audited self-employed dates,
  provisional tax on 31 July and 31 December, the 2026 return, and what each missed date
  costs.
- [Paying the balance of your 2025 Cyprus tax return](https://cyprustaxcalculator.abasis.ai/guides/pay-tax-balance/):
  where the amount to pay comes from, the Tax Portal and its 13-digit payment reference
  code, card or internet banking, the 31 October 2026 deadline and how to check the
  payment.
- [The bank account for Cyprus tax refunds: form T.D.2008](https://cyprustaxcalculator.abasis.ai/guides/refund-bank-account/):
  registering or changing the IBAN the Tax Department pays refunds into: form T.D.2008,
  the bank’s IBAN certificate, Tax For All with CY Login from 5 October 2026, and when a
  2025 refund arrives.
- [Am I a Cyprus tax resident? The 183-day and 60-day rules](https://cyprustaxcalculator.abasis.ai/guides/tax-resident/):
  how the days are counted, every condition of the 60-day rule for 2025 and for 2026,
  the condition Ν.244(Ι)/2025 removed, what residence changes, and what to answer in the
  return.
- [Am I domiciled in Cyprus? Domicile and the defence contribution](https://cyprustaxcalculator.abasis.ai/guides/domicile/):
  domicile of origin under Cap. 195, the two exceptions, the 17-of-20 rule and, from
  2026, the 20 years abroad it takes to lose it — with the €250,000 option and the rates
  it decides.
- [Changing your address and personal details with the Cyprus Tax Department](https://cyprustaxcalculator.abasis.ai/guides/change-your-details/):
  phones, addresses and email you change yourself in the Tax For All profile; name,
  category and activity go on form T.D.2003, sent as a message in the same portal.
- [Registering for VAT in Cyprus as an individual](https://cyprustaxcalculator.abasis.ai/guides/vat-registration/):
  the two €15,600 tests, thirty days to notify and €85 a month for missing it, the paper
  form T.D.1101, and the EU services that need a VAT number from the first invoice.
- [Registering with Social Insurance as self-employed in Cyprus](https://cyprustaxcalculator.abasis.ai/guides/social-insurance-self-employed/):
  registration from the first day on form Υ.Κ.Α. 1-013, 16.6% of your category’s
  insurable earnings each quarter, the HRDA levy from 6 April 2026, and GESY collected
  alongside.

## Worked examples

Typical cases computed by the calculator's own engine at page load, 2025 and 2026
side by side, line by line. Each exists in English, Greek and Russian at
/examples/<slug>/, /el/examples/<slug>/ and /ru/examples/<slug>/.

- [Examples index](https://cyprustaxcalculator.abasis.ai/examples/)
- [An employee on €28,000](https://cyprustaxcalculator.abasis.ai/examples/employee-28000/): income tax, social insurance and GESY under the 2025 bands and the 2026 reform.
- [An employee on €60,000](https://cyprustaxcalculator.abasis.ai/examples/employee-60000/): the same, further up the scale; social insurance comes off before tax.
- [A couple with two children](https://cyprustaxcalculator.abasis.ai/examples/family-two-children/): the 2026 child and rent deductions inside the €100,000 family limit.
- [An executive with the 50% exemption](https://cyprustaxcalculator.abasis.ai/examples/relocated-50-percent/): article 8(23A) on €120,000: what the exemption reaches and the 2026 social insurance ceiling.
- [A returnee with the 25% exemption](https://cyprustaxcalculator.abasis.ai/examples/returnee-25-percent/): article 8(21B) on €50,000.
- [An employee who lets a flat](https://cyprustaxcalculator.abasis.ai/examples/landlord/): rent taxed with salary less 20%, GESY on rent, and the end of defence contribution on rent in 2026.
- [A non-domiciled resident living on investments](https://cyprustaxcalculator.abasis.ai/examples/non-dom-investor/): dividends and interest: no income tax, no defence contribution, GESY only.

## FAQ topics covered on the calculator page

Tax brackets and filing, income thresholds, child deductions, the housing
deduction, energy and EV deductions, home insurance, rental income under the
2026 changes, life insurance and penalties, the 20%/25%/50% exemptions, special
tax elections, deduction limits and caps, and how deductions apply monthly.

## Sources

The calculations and FAQ follow the Cyprus Tax Department's published guidance
on the 2026 tax reform, including the explanatory guide, worked examples, the
official FAQ for individuals, and the employer income tax withholding
calculation tool. Links to each document are listed in the "Official References
& Forms" section of the calculator page.
